name: Charisteria
summary: Artemis Agrotera's thanksgiving after Marathon — the annual herd of goats vowed for the Persian dead, led out by the ephebes to the Huntress across the Ilissus.
testimonia: Xenophon, Anabasis 3.2.12 (the vow of a goat for every enemy slain)
Plutarch, On the Malice of Herodotus 862b–c (the yearly five hundred goats)
Pausanias 1.19.6 (the temple of Artemis Agrotera at Agrae)
